summary: Validado o fluxo mobile de onboarding, dashboard, treino, registro de série, navegação, analytics, coach SSE e ausência de overflow; APIs root/bootstrap, sets, analytics e weekly-report passaram. Recovery inicialmente retornava 500 por ObjectId Mongo e foi corrigido.
action_items: Considerar persistir os valores de carga/reps editados pelo usuário no POST de sets; a UI atualmente envia carga/reps fixos do programa.
critical_code_review_comments: Recovery serialization bug fixed: response now excludes MongoDB _id.
Profile/onboarding selections are only local UI state and are not POSTed to /api/profiles, so custom onboarding choices do not persist to MongoDB or update the dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_forge set and one TEST_forge recovery record for API validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested at forge-engine-7.preview.emergentagent.com. Coach returned real Portuguese streaming response. Initial recovery 500 was reproduced and fixed; rerun backend test before further changes.
rca of the issue: POST /api/recovery inserted the document into MongoDB and returned the same dict, which acquired _id during insert_one; FastAPI JSON encoding could not serialize bson ObjectId. Returning a filtered dict, matching /api/sets, resolves the 500.
